corpusLevels.reconciliationNote: Orphanet product1 lists every nomenclature row: Disorder, Subtype of disorder, and Group of disorders. The figure 11,645 is that full row count. The commonly cited “about 7,000 rare diseases” aligns with the Disorder level alone (clinical disease entities), not with groups or every subtype. This atlas samples from usable non-group rows after dropping OBSOLETE: and NON RARE IN EUROPE: preferred names.
